settings.heading: From first question to final knot.
settings.intro: A clear, collaborative path to a rug you will live with for years.
settings.body: We keep the process personal and transparent, whether you are choosing from the collection or developing something entirely new.

settings.heading: Discover
settings.text: We learn about your space, your taste, and what the rug needs to do.

settings.heading: Develop
settings.text: We guide material, colour, scale, and construction with practical advice.

settings.heading: Deliver
settings.text: Your finished rug is checked, prepared, and sent ready for its place.
